product_metadata.title: Calvin Klein Home Solid Color Queen Sheet Set of 4 Pieces - 1 Queen Flat Sheet,1 Deep Pocket Queen Fitted Sheet and 2 Pillowcases, 100% Cotton 300 Tc (Navy Blue)
features: Make a subtle statement and bring a serene look to your bedroom with the Calvin Klein Signature Sheet Set. These luxurious, soft sheet sets are made of 100% cotton in 300 thread count and features a smart CK logo label to add iconic design to your sleeping space
It is available in four colours - white, grey, cloud and navy blue
This premium quality sheet set is wrinkle-free and fade resistant, the smooth, light weight fabric also makes it breathable and comfortable for a good night's sleep

Each Queen size set includes one flat sheet (92 inch x 108 inch), one fully elasticized fitted sheet (60 inch x 80 inch + 17 inch deep pocket) and two standard pillow cases (20 inch x 30 inch). Fitted Sheet has deep pockets to fit mattresses from 9" to 20". Flat sheet & pillowcases come with a classic Z hem tailored stitch for a hotel collection look. Highest quality dye materials are used for fade resistance.
Wash care: Machine wash warm 60°C separately, do not bleach, tumble drying at low temperature. Recommended - regular wash and short dry cycles for superior softness

QUALITY CERTIFIED STANDARD 100 by OEKO-TEX - Made in a vertically integrated factory certified for ISO-9001:2008, ISO-14001:2004 & ISO-18001:2007. SEDEX, OEKO-TEX and BSCI complied facility ensures sustainability, contribution to environment and corporate social responsibility. The fabric is thoroughly tested for meeting performance like no pilling, shrinkage, color fastness, tear strength and thread count authenticity before being individually measured and stitched to perfection
description: Calvin Klein is one the most popular lifestyle brands and speak of bold and progressive ideals. Calvin Klein Home Signature Sateen Navy Blue Sheet set is woven in 100% Cotton with 300 TC. This stylish bedroom essential is a must have. It comes in a set of of 4 Pieces is an ideal gift for any occassion. Durable, breathable and long lasting this Sheet set is ideal for everyday use.
